Syriac., p. 5, ed. Bruns and Kirsch.

summary.headline: Glycas on Astronomy and Astrology
summary.text: Glycas condemns judicial astrology while permitting astronomy as the study of heavenly motions, seasons, and the divine order of the stars. He cites Uriel’s instruction of Seth and Enoch and distinguishes astronomical investigation from astrological divination of the future.
